meta_description: Izimbo zakho zokubhala, kuzo zonke ii-app zakho. Bhala kwakhona, tolika, phendula.
h1: Bhala ngo*simbo sakho*, kuzo zonke ii-app zakho.
accroche: Umyalezo awunalo ilizwi elifanayo kwi-imeyile yomsebenzi, isibhengezo esincinci okanye umyalezo kumntu omthandayo. I-Plume yindawo yezimbo zakho zokubhala: ukhetha esakho, sisebenza kwi-app ekuyo. Ugcina ikhibhodi yakho, i-app yakho, yaye nguwe othumelayo.
demo_complice: Ewe kakhulu, ndiyafumaneka ngomso! Ndixelele ixesha elikulungeleyo.
demo_consigne: Khetha isimbo, emva koko cofa ikhapsuli.
geste_intro: I-Plume ibeka ikhapsuli encinci ehambahambayo phezu kwee-app ozikhethayo. Kwezinye iindawo, ayibonakali.
tap_texte: Umbhalo wakho ubhalwa kwakhona ngesimbo esikhethiweyo, okanye utolikwe.
micro_texte: Uyathetha, umbhalo wakho ubhalwa kwindawo yokubhala.
styles_intro: Apha, isimbo sokubhala sibizwa ngokuba yi-persona. Ezinye zinikwa simahla, ezinye zikulindele kwikhathalogi.
styles_tienne_texte: Ngokubhalisa, wenza ii-persona zakho: i-Plume ibhala njengawe, hayi njengabo bonke.
regles_texte: Nika i-app nganye i-persona okanye imodi: imiyalezo yakho nge-Ngobuhlobo, inethiwekhi yomsebenzi nge-Ngobuchule. Ilizwi elifanelekileyo lisebenza ngokukhawuleza xa uvula.
regles_note: Ii-app ongazilungiselelanga zilandela isimbo sakho sokuqala.
lecture_texte: Tolika into oyifundayo: i-manga, i-webtoon, i-app yaphesheya. Uguqulelo luvela phezu kombhalo, endaweni yawo: ufunda ngolwimi lwakho ungakopi nto.
lecture_langues: I-Plume ithetha ulwimi lwakho, yaye igqibelela ngokutolika kwezinye ezininzi.
lecture_consigne: Cofa « Tolika »: uguqulelo lubekwa phezu kombhalo.
conf_titre: Apho umbhalo wakho usetyenzwa khona, *nguwe ukhetha*
local_texte: Imodi yasekhaya itolika kwifowuni yakho: akukho nto ithunyelwayo, isebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi — kodwa zonke iilwimi azigutyungelwa ngokulinganayo apho.
cloud_texte: Imodi ye-Cloud AI isebenzisa ilizwi le-persona yakho yaye incedisa ezi lwimi; umbhalo wakho uthunyelwa kwinkonzo ye-AI ekwingingqi engaphandle kweYurophu, ixesha lokusetyenzwa. I-Plume ayigcini nto.
ia_texte: Ukubhalisa kudibanisa i-AI esebenza kwisixhobo: ngaphandle kwe-intanethi, ngaphandle komda.
autorisations_texte: I-Plume isebenzisa inkonzo yokufikelela ye-Android ukufunda nokutshintsha umbhalo kwindawo obhala kuyo, xa ucofa ikhapsuli, yaye kuphela kwii-app ozidibanise nazo. Ukufunda okunceda kucela imvume yakho yokufotwa kwesikrini rhoqo xa uqala. Ayithumeli nto ngasemva, yaye ayithumeli myalezo egameni lakho.
final_texte: I-Plume isetyenziswa simahla, kunani elithile lokubhala kwakhona ngosuku; isibhengezo esinomvuzo sivula ngakumbi, asinyanzelwa. Ukubhalisa kunyusa imida, kuvula yonke ikhathalogi yaye kususa izibhengezo.
final_signature: I-Plume ayikufundisi ukubhala. Ikunika ilizwi elifanelekileyo, ngexesha obhala ngalo.
autorisations_sans_lecture: I-Plume isebenzisa inkonzo yokufikelela ye-Android ukufunda nokutshintsha umbhalo kwindawo obhala kuyo, xa ucofa ikhapsuli, yaye kuphela kwii-app ozidibanise nazo. Ayithumeli nto ngasemva, yaye ayithumeli myalezo egameni lakho.
